# CLI

Run with `npx crouton <command>`.

## generate

Generate a CRUD collection

| Argument | Type | Alias | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<layer>` | positional |  |  | Target layer |
| `<collection>` | positional |  |  | Collection name |
| `--fieldsFile` | string | `-f` |  | Path to JSON schema file |
| `--config` | string | `-c` |  | Use config file instead of CLI args |
| `--dialect` | string | `-d` | `sqlite` | Database dialect (only sqlite is supported) |
| `--dryRun` | boolean |  |  | Preview without writing |
| `--noTranslations` | boolean |  |  | Skip translation fields |
| `--force` | boolean |  |  | Force generation despite missing dependencies |
| `--noDb` | boolean |  |  | Skip database table creation |
| `--hierarchy` | boolean |  |  | Enable hierarchy support (parentId, path, depth, order) |
| `--seed` | boolean |  |  | Generate seed data file using drizzle-seed |
| `--count` | string |  | `25` | Number of seed records (default: 25) |
| `--tests` | boolean |  | `false` | Also emit per-collection tests (schema smoke + API handlers); off by default |
| `--noAutoMerge` | boolean |  |  | Skip the setup questions of extended packages |

| `<configPath>` | positional |  |  | Config file path |
| `--only` | string |  |  | Generate only a specific collection |

| `--force` | boolean |  |  | Force generation |
| `--tests` | boolean |  | `false` | Also emit per-collection tests (schema smoke + API handlers); off by default |

## init

Create a new crouton app end-to-end (scaffold → generate → doctor → summary)

| Argument | Type | Alias | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<name>` | positional |  |  | App name |
| `--features` | string |  | `` | Comma-separated feature names (e.g., bookings,pages,editor) |
| `--theme` | string |  |  | Theme to wire into extends (e.g., ko) |
| `--dialect` | string | `-d` | `sqlite` | Database dialect (only sqlite is supported) |
| `--noCf` | boolean |  |  | Skip Cloudflare-specific config (wrangler.jsonc, CF stubs) |
| `--domain` | string |  |  | Cloudflare zone for custom-domain routes (e.g. pmcp.dev → <app>.pmcp.dev / <app>-preview.pmcp.dev) |
| `--poc` | boolean |  |  | Scaffold into pocs/<name> (the incubator) instead of apps/<name> |
| `--out` | string |  |  | Explicit target directory (overrides --poc; default apps/<name>) |
| `--dryRun` | boolean |  |  | Preview what will be generated without writing files |

## add

Add Crouton modules or features to your project

| Argument | Type | Alias | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--skipMigrations` | boolean |  |  | Skip migration generation and application |
| `--skipInstall` | boolean |  |  | Skip package installation (assume already installed) |
| `--dryRun` | boolean |  |  | Preview what will be done without making changes |
| `--force` | boolean |  |  | Force reinstall even if already installed |
| `--list` | boolean |  |  | List all available modules |

## rollback

| Argument | Type | Alias | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<layer>` | positional |  |  | Layer name |
| `<collection>` | positional |  |  | Collection name |
| `--dryRun` | boolean |  |  | Preview what will be removed |
| `--keepFiles` | boolean |  |  | Keep generated files, only clean configs |
| `--dropTable` | boolean |  |  | Also emit a DROP TABLE migration for the removed table (preview with --dry-run) |
| `--force` | boolean |  |  | Skip confirmation prompts |
